title.narrative: A national plan for improvement of water, sanitation and hygiene services and infection prevention and control was developed and 569 health workers were trained. Climate-resilient WASH standards for schools and an eco-friendly warehouse manual for the Ministry of Education were developed, addressing key WASH challenges in various sectors.
